changelog: **External Correction — two new overshoot brakes for aggressive settings.** If a faster/more aggressive correction made the aim overshoot the target, two switches in the External-Correction tab now help — both **off by default**, so nothing changes until you turn them on. **In-Flight-Reduktion** stops the correction from re-commanding what it has already sent but not yet seen (it accounts for the round-trip delay), so you can push sensitivity harder without overshoot. **Nah-Ziel-Limit** eases the speed as you close on the target for a soft landing without overshoot on arrival. Each has one slider (amount / knee distance).
